thread:
mara-cs: FYI - NimbusPay (dedicated) flagged slowdown during peak billing window. p95 up ~22% yesterday PM, while overall errors stayed <0.3%. Their renewal touchpoint is in 3 weeks so want to be proactive.

jon-ops: Any recent infra changes?

mara-cs: No infra changes from us. They reported switching to batched uploads and longer user contexts (median tokens ~680). Traffic also spiked +18% after a marketing promo.

sam-ml: Sounds like KV cache churn + longer decode lengths. Recommend short-query routing: tokens<=512 -> compact-q1@int8, else -> base-lr@fp16. Also suggest prefix caching for repeated invoice headers.

riley-se: We need a tiny QA matrix before canary: semantic-accuracy on top 10 intents, PII-check on outputs, and cost delta estimate. If accuracy drop >2% we rollback.

sam-ml: Proposed canary: 12h window, 12% of eligible short-query traffic. Eval metrics: top-intent F1, p50/p95 latency, token cost per 1k.

mara-cs: I'll propose this to the Nimbus PM and highlight renewal benefit (proactive ops).

jon-ops: I'll pre-warm KV and add temporary prefix cache TTL=4m. Also set auto-throttle if QPS > 3.5k.

infra-bot: Canary created -> canary-8421 scheduled in 20m.

sam-ml: Minimal canary payload (for infra run):

```
POST /v1/accounts/nimbuspay/canary
{
  "predicate": "tokens <= 512",
  "fraction": 0.12,
  "model": "compact-q1",
  "quant": "int8",
  "rollback_on": "p95 > baseline*1.10 or top_intent_f1_drop > 0.02"
}
```

riley-se: I'll compile the QA checklist and compliance sign-off note. Also update renewal tracker: "offered perf canary - pending PM approval".

mara-cs: Thanks team — next steps: get PM sign-off, run canary, collect evals, decision within 24h of canary finish. I'll post results here. /end
